name: AgentCrucible
tagline: Break tool calls. Check what committed and what the agent claimed.
description: Fault injection for tool-using agents: seeded failures, committed-state grading, replay, a local console, and CI regression checks.
summary: A fault-testing tool for AI agents: break their tool calls, compare their answers with what actually committed, and replay the evidence.

lead.caption: The v2.1.0 console with Northwind, a fictional demo workspace. Its scenarios run through the real engine; its eight weeks of history are generated demo data.
lead.alt: AgentCrucible's local console showing the Northwind demo workspace: verdict trends, agent version markers, fault coverage, and results needing attention. All displayed history is demo data.
